'''Korvalus Tower''' was a residential tower located in the [[Axial Park]] district's [[Archival Square]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Thousands of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high, the tower was home to thousands of civilians,<ref name="Firestorm" /> and in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref> during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the latter's forces seized control of the building.<ref name="Firestorm" />

They installed weapons known as the [[Firestorm Turbolaser]] in the upper floors of [[Gowix Corp superstructure|several]] [[Tyrelli Habitat|buildings]], including Korvalus Tower, as part of Operation Firestorm&mdash;a Sith plot designed by the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] to inflict heavy casualties in Axial Park with the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] flew an [[Imperial assault shuttle|assault shuttle]] to one of the tower's landing pads and infiltrated Korvalus Tower, eliminating the Imperials and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] within and destroying the Firestorm Turbolaser. The top floor featured large red [[Carpet/Legends|carpets]] and indoor potted [[Plant/Legends|plants]], as with other buildings in the city at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Firestorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korvalus Tower appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class-restricted phase for the Jedi Knight class mission "Firestorm."<ref name="Firestorm" />
